artworks.title: Sheet of Seven Roundels with Portraits
artworks.description: The image depicts seven circular portraits of individuals. These portraits focus on the facial features, attire, and hair of the individuals. The portraits show a variety of historical headwear and collars, suggesting a European historical theme. The individuals are shown from the chest up, facing either to the side or directly forward. They have different facial hair arrangements, with some having beards and mustaches, while others are clean-shaven. The hair styles range from neatly fashioned to more natural and flowing. The clothing includes ornate garments with elaborate collars and decorative patterns. The background is a plain, textured paper. The portraits are evenly spaced across the paper. Each portrait is surrounded by inscriptions or names in an old-style font.

artworks.title: Sheet of Seven Roundels with Portraits
artworks.description: The image consists of six circular illustrations on a plain background. Each circle contains detailed depictions similar to coins or medallions. In the center is a crest with a stylized lion, bordered by scrollwork and a crown. Surrounding the central crest are four portraits of individuals in elaborate period attire. Two illustrations depict women in ornate dresses and elaborate hairstyles, adorned with decorative collars and necklaces. Two other illustrations portray men with distinctive facial features, dressed in high-collared garments with intricate patterns. There is another circular design featuring two crossed batons beneath crowns. Each circular frame is rimmed with writing, presumably names and titles related to the figures within. The background is a plain textured surface.

There is a pin on the side of the hat. The background features a circular design with text around the perimeter.

They are wearing a period garment with an elaborate collar resembling lace or ruffles. The circular illustration includes text along the edges within a dark, cross-hatched background.

artworks.title: Charles, Prince of Wales

He wears an elaborate collar, likely made of lace, common in historical formal wear, that extends outward with a high neckline framing his neck. The portrait is bordered by inscribed text, set against a background patterned with fine lines and dots. The aged paper background is beige with visible age spots.

artworks.title: James I, King of England

He has a composed expression, with a short beard and mustache. His hair appears to be neatly styled under a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a jewel or badge. The man is dressed in ornate clothing featuring an elaborate ruffled collar typical of the period, along with a jacket embellished with buttons and intricate patterns. Around him is a circular border with text. The background inside the circle is plain, while the outer border contains decorative elements. The surrounding area outside the circular illustration is a simple, neutral space, without any additional design or imagery.

The image is set against a plain, slightly aged background typical of historical paper.

artworks.title: Charles, Prince of Wales

His hair is short to medium in length, styled upwards and back, revealing his forehead. The man wears an elaborate ruffled collar and richly textured clothing. The circle surrounding him contains intricate detailing and text. The background is plain, with the image centered on a cream-colored paper with a slightly rough texture.

The person's face is positioned forward in the center of the circle, with a soft expression, large eyes, a slightly open mouth, and voluminous, textured hair styled high and away from the face. The person wears a garment with visible detailing around the collar area and is adorned with a string of pearls around the neck. This circular portrait is enclosed by a text band that includes a name or inscription, partially readable. The background of the image is a plain, lightly textured beige surface with some faint markings midway down and near the bottom edge.

Surrounding the portrait is a decorative circular frame with inscriptions. The background consists of the plain paper ground on which the portrait is printed, devoid of any other decorative element. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom of the image.
